title: Subdistricts
previewText:
In order to carry out the purposes and provisions of this Chapter, six subdistricts are established as follows:

Subdistrict A Subdistrict B Subdistrict C Subdistrict D Subdistrict E Subdistrict F

amendmentHistory.description: Modifying Article XIII, Chapter 5 (Special Bay Street Corridor District), to create a new Subdistrict F, and APPENDIX F for the purpose of establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area.

amendmentHistory.notes: Five Subdistricts (A-E) and four Subareas (B1, B2, D1, D2)
